events.text: Spirits spooked them; cattle never miss an excuse.
events.speaker: ELEANOR

events.text: Save me a place; your outfit could use a steady hand.
events.speaker: ELEANOR

events.text: Easy, sweetheart; the dead can wait their turn.
events.speaker: ELEANOR

events.text: There, a steady breath beats another argument with a ghost.
events.speaker: ELEANOR

events.text: Three settled, and nobody bit me; back to the wagon for tea.
events.speaker: ELEANOR

events.text: You kept the kettle warm for me; I could get used to that.
events.speaker: ELEANOR

events.text: Sit beside me; for once, the world can look after itself.
events.speaker: ELEANOR

events.text: That smile suits you; come closer and let me enjoy it.
events.speaker: ELEANOR

events.text: Ready again; let's finish settling those nerves.
events.speaker: ELEANOR

events.text: Six safe, and you still look presentable; come see me by the wagon.
events.speaker: ELEANOR

events.text: Alvarez sets bones; I settle spirits. He thinks that split is cleaner than it is.
events.speaker: ELEANOR
